analysis.summaryJa: as ... asを定型表現へ広げ、可能な限り、相変わらず、AというよりB、〜さえしない、ほとんど〜同然といった会話的な意味を表す。
grammarPoints: as ... as possibleで可能な限りを表す
as ... as everで相変わらず・これまで同様を表す
not so much A as BでAというよりBを表す
not so much asとas good asを一まとまりで覚える
visualEvidence: possibleへ伸びる矢印が到達できる限界を示す
everの循環矢印が以前と変わらない状態を示す
AからBへ重心が移る図がnot so much A as Bを示す
as good asの等号が実質的な完了・同然を示す
commonTraps: possibleの前で二つ目のasを落とさない
not so much A as Bを単なる数量比較と誤解しない
not so much asの後は動詞原形などを置く
as good asを常に品質比較と解釈しない

questions.prompt: Please return the signed agreement as soon as -------.
questions.translationJa: 署名済み契約書をできるだけ早く返送してください。
questions.explanationJa: 定型表現as soon as possibleが必要です。

questions.prompt: Despite the tight deadline, Ms. Flores was as calm as ------- during the client call.
questions.translationJa: 厳しい期限にもかかわらず、フローレスさんは顧客との電話で相変わらず落ち着いていました。
questions.explanationJa: as calm as everで以前と同じく落ち着いている意味です。

questions.prompt: The delay was not so much a technical failure ------- a scheduling error.
questions.translationJa: 遅延は技術的故障というより日程上の誤りでした。
questions.explanationJa: AというよりBはnot so much A as Bで表します。
questions.focus: not so much A as B

questions.prompt: The vendor did not so much ------- our complaint until we called a third time.
questions.translationJa: 3回目に電話するまで、業者は苦情を認めることさえしませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: did not so much asのasが文中で省略されていない前提で、didの後は動詞原形です。
questions.focus: not so much as + 動詞原形

questions.prompt: With the final permit issued, the renovation is as good ------- complete.
questions.translationJa: 最終許可が出たので、改装はほぼ完了したも同然です。
questions.explanationJa: as good as completeで実質的に完了という意味です。

questions.prompt: To avoid congestion, employees should submit travel requests as early as -------.
questions.translationJa: 混雑を避けるため、出張申請はできるだけ早く提出してください。
questions.explanationJa: as early as possibleという定型句です。

questions.prompt: The redesign is not so much simpler as ------- intuitive for first-time users.
questions.translationJa: 再設計版は単に簡単というより、初回利用者にとってより直感的です。
questions.explanationJa: not so much A as Bで、B側に比較級more intuitiveを置きます。
questions.focus: not so much A as Bの対比

questions.prompt: The report was submitted on time, but the author did not so much as ------- the attached data table.
questions.translationJa: 報告書は期限内に提出されましたが、作成者は添付表を確認さえしませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: did not so much asの後は動詞原形checkです。
questions.focus: not so much as + 原形

questions.prompt: The customer lounge looks as welcoming as ------- after last month's repairs.
questions.translationJa: 先月の修理後も顧客ラウンジは相変わらず居心地よく見えます。
questions.explanationJa: as welcoming as everで変わらない高い状態を示します。

questions.prompt: The merger is as good as ------- now that both boards have approved it.
questions.translationJa: 両取締役会が承認したので、合併は事実上確定です。
questions.explanationJa: as good asの後に形容詞finalを置き、ほぼ確定の意味にします。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly makes an urgent request?

choices.B: Please respond as quickly as possible.
choices.C: Please respond as more quickly as possible.

questions.translationJa: できるだけ速やかに返信してください。
questions.explanationJa: as quickly as possibleの二つのasが必要です。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly says the manager remains energetic?

choices.A: The manager is energetic than ever as.
choices.B: The manager is as energetic ever.
choices.C: The manager is as more energetic as ever.
choices.D: The manager is as energetic as ever.

questions.translationJa: その管理者は相変わらず精力的です。
questions.explanationJa: 変わらない状態はas energetic as everで表します。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly contrasts the cause?

choices.A: It was not so much a cost issue as a timing issue.
choices.B: It was not as much a cost issue than timing.
choices.C: It was so not much cost as a timing issue.
choices.D: It was not much a cost issue as more timing.

questions.translationJa: それは費用の問題というより時期の問題でした。
questions.explanationJa: not so much A as Bの定型語順が正しい文です。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly means the assistant did not even call?

choices.A: The assistant did not so much called us.
choices.B: The assistant did not as much as calling us.
choices.C: The assistant did not so much as call us.
choices.D: The assistant did not so many as calls us.

questions.translationJa: その担当者は私たちに電話さえしませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: did not so much asの後は原形callです。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly says the work is virtually finished?

choices.A: The installation is good as completed.
choices.B: The installation is as better as complete.
choices.C: The installation is as good than complete.
choices.D: The installation is as good as complete.

questions.translationJa: 設置作業はほぼ完了したも同然です。
questions.explanationJa: as good as completeが事実上完了を表します。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly asks for maximum detail?

choices.A: Describe the incident as detail as possible.
choices.B: Describe the incident as detailed as possibly.
choices.C: Describe the incident in as much detail as possible.
choices.D: Describe the incident more much detail as possible.

questions.translationJa: その出来事をできるだけ詳しく説明してください。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算detailにはin as much detail as possibleを使います。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly emphasizes unchanged reliability?

choices.A: The backup system is reliable as ever as.
choices.B: The backup system is as reliable as ever.
choices.C: The backup system is ever as more reliable.
choices.D: The backup system is as reliable than ever.

questions.translationJa: 予備システムは相変わらず信頼できます。
questions.explanationJa: as reliable as everが正しいまとまりです。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly contrasts style and substance?

choices.A: The update is not so much cosmetic as functional.
choices.B: The update is not cosmetic so much than functional.
choices.C: The update is no so much cosmetic as functionally.
choices.D: The update is not as much cosmetic more functional.

questions.translationJa: その更新は見た目上というより機能上のものです。
questions.explanationJa: 同じ品詞のcosmeticとfunctionalをnot so much A as Bで対比します。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly means no acknowledgment was given?

choices.A: They did not so much as acknowledged the request.
choices.B: They did not much as acknowledge so the request.
choices.C: They had not so many as acknowledge the request.
choices.D: They did not so much as acknowledge the request.

questions.translationJa: 彼らは依頼を認めることさえしませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: did not so much as + 原形acknowledgeが正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly says approval is virtually certain?

choices.B: Approval is as good as guaranteed.
choices.C: Approval is as well as guarantee.
choices.D: Approval is as better as guaranteed.

questions.translationJa: 承認はほぼ確実です。
questions.explanationJa: as good as guaranteedで事実上保証された状態を表します。

questions.prompt: Please send the corrected invoice as soon as possible.

choices.A: Send it only after the next billing cycle.
choices.D: Send it at the earliest practical time.

questions.translationJa: 訂正請求書を可能な限り早く送ってください。
questions.explanationJa: as soon as possibleは実行可能な最短時点を求めます。

questions.prompt: The support desk is as responsive as ever.

choices.B: It remains just as responsive as before.
choices.C: It has never responded to anyone.
choices.D: It is less responsive than every other desk.

questions.translationJa: 支援窓口は相変わらず反応が速いです。
questions.explanationJa: as ... as everは以前と同じ程度が続く意味です。

questions.prompt: The problem is not so much the software as the way it was configured.

choices.A: Only the software can be blamed.
choices.C: The configuration, rather than the software itself, is the main problem.
choices.D: The software and configuration are equally irrelevant.

questions.translationJa: 問題はソフト自体というより設定方法です。
questions.explanationJa: not so much A as BはB側を本質として強調します。

questions.prompt: The contractor did not so much as inspect the damaged panel.

choices.A: The contractor did not even inspect it.
choices.B: The contractor replaced it after inspection.

questions.translationJa: 請負業者は損傷パネルを点検さえしませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: not so much asは最低限の行為さえしない意味です。

questions.prompt: The contract is as good as signed.

choices.A: The parties refuse to discuss it.
choices.B: It is virtually certain to be signed or effectively settled.
choices.C: Its wording is of excellent quality.

questions.translationJa: 契約は署名済みも同然です。
questions.explanationJa: as good as signedは品質ではなく実質的な完了を表します。
questions.focus: as good asの比喩的意味

questions.prompt: Keep the customer informed as fully as possible.

choices.C: Wait until the customer asks twice.
choices.D: Provide the greatest practical amount of information.

questions.translationJa: 顧客に可能な限り十分な情報を伝えてください。
questions.explanationJa: as fully as possibleは可能な最大限の程度を表します。

questions.prompt: Ms. Kim is as efficient as ever despite the office move.

choices.B: She stopped working during the move.
choices.C: She is now the least efficient employee.

questions.translationJa: 移転にもかかわらず、キムさんは相変わらず効率的です。
questions.explanationJa: as efficient as everは従来の効率を維持している意味です。

questions.prompt: The meeting was not so much unproductive as poorly timed.

choices.A: The meeting achieved nothing because nobody attended.
choices.C: The main criticism concerns timing rather than productivity.
choices.D: Productivity and timing were never evaluated.

questions.translationJa: 会議は非生産的というより、時期が悪かったのです。
questions.explanationJa: B側のpoor timingが主な評価だと示します。
questions.focus: not so much A as Bの解釈

questions.prompt: The shipment is as good as lost after two months without tracking data.

choices.A: It can reasonably be treated as lost.

questions.translationJa: 2か月追跡情報がないため、その荷物は紛失したも同然です。
questions.explanationJa: as good as lostは実質的に紛失と判断できる意味です。
questions.focus: as good as + 過去分詞

questions.prompt: The supplier did not so much as apologize for the delay.

choices.A: The supplier offered a full refund.
choices.D: The supplier failed even to apologize.

questions.translationJa: 供給業者は遅延について謝罪さえしませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: not so much as apologizeはnot even apologizeと同じ意味です。

questions.prompt: The client needs the figures for an afternoon briefing. Please finish the calculation -------.
questions.translationJa: 午後説明に必要なため、計算をできるだけ早く終えてください。
questions.explanationJa: 緊急性にはas quickly as possibleが合います。

questions.prompt: The branch moved twice this year, but its staff still answer inquiries promptly. The team is -------.
questions.translationJa: 移転後も、そのチームは相変わらず迅速に対応します。
questions.explanationJa: 変化の中でも状態が続くのでas responsive as everです。

questions.prompt: The package arrived, but the courier left without obtaining a signature. He did not ------- ask for one.
questions.translationJa: 配達員は署名を求めることさえしませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: did not so much as askで最低限の行為の欠如を表します。

questions.prompt: The revised policy changes how requests are approved, not how many are accepted. It is ------- procedural as numerical.
questions.translationJa: 改訂方針は数量的というより手続き的な変更です。
questions.explanationJa: not so much numerical as proceduralの対比を完成させます。

questions.prompt: Both negotiating teams have accepted the final price and wording. The agreement is now ------- concluded.
questions.translationJa: 双方が条件を受け入れたため、合意はほぼ成立済みです。
questions.explanationJa: as good as concludedで事実上成立した状態を表します。
questions.focus: as good as + 過去分詞

questions.prompt: The audit found no fraud; the issue was weak record keeping. The case is ------- a crime as an administrative failure.
questions.translationJa: その件は犯罪というより管理上の不備です。
questions.explanationJa: not so much A as BでBを本質として示します。

questions.prompt: The network upgrade begins tonight. Back up all essential files ------- before leaving.
questions.translationJa: 退社前に重要ファイルを可能な限り完全にバックアップしてください。
questions.explanationJa: 動詞back upを副詞completelyで修飾しas ... as possibleを作ります。

questions.prompt: Even after ten years, the original training video remains clear and relevant. It is ------- useful as ever.
questions.translationJa: 10年後もその研修動画は以前と同じくらい役立ちます。
questions.explanationJa: just as useful as everで変わらない有用性を強調します。

questions.prompt: The inspection request was marked urgent, yet the contractor did not ------- open the attached photographs.
questions.translationJa: 緊急指定なのに、請負業者は添付写真を開きさえしませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: did not so much as openが文脈に合います。
questions.focus: not so much as + 動詞

questions.prompt: The final test passed every requirement, and production begins tomorrow. The development phase is ------- finished.
questions.translationJa: 全要件を満たしたため、開発段階は事実上終了です。
questions.explanationJa: as good as finishedでほぼ完了を表します。
